promotionRule: Every qualification item must succeed after the workflow has checked out and mechanically verified the exact proposed head commit. Missing, queued, skipped, stale, synthetic-merge-only, source-only, or ancestor evidence is not PASS.
forbiddenClaims: A queued or absent workflow is green evidence.
A synthetic pull-request merge ref is exact-head evidence.
A RoyaltyPayment row creates or extinguishes a royalty obligation.
A worker queue is settlement authority.
Submitted, accepted or confirmed rail state is final settlement.
Merkle inclusion proofs are zero-knowledge proofs.
A DDEX or CISAC CRD projection is the internal accounting ledger.
A serialized source snapshot is signing authority without canonical accounting replay.
